app.name: Silsilah
app.tagline: Turn handwritten family trees into a family archive you can share.

home.step2: Check what we read and fix any mistakes
home.privacy: Your trees are private unless you invite someone.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
login.checkBody: We sent a sign-in link to your inbox. It works once and expires in one hour.
login.checkSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or go back and try again.
login.error: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.
login.inviteHint: Sign in to join the family tree you were invited to.

trees.title: My trees
trees.empty: You don't have any family trees yet.

tree.noPeople: No people in this tree yet.
tree.comingSoon: Photo upload, the review screen and the tree chart arrive in the next phases.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.body: You've been invited to join “{tree}” as {role}.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
invite.used: This invitation has already been used.
invite.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address to accept it.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that page, or you don't have access to it.

admin.title: Admin
admin.privacyNote: App-wide numbers only. Being an admin doesn't give you access to anyone's family tree.
admin.howToChange: Admins are set in the ADMIN_EMAILS environment variable. Change it in Vercel and redeploy.
admin.comingSoon: Merge-suggestion tuning statistics arrive with phase 5.
